facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_偏财 (Fire carrying The Horizon). Persona The Horizon (偏财). Definition line: "Wide-ranging engagement, opportunity sensed at a distance". Keyword Reach, charge dynamic, poles catalyst Momentum / friction Scatter. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: opportunity sensed far off; the near things blur. Arena: horizon, wind, open road, far light, the next place. Classical portrait: wide-ranging engagement; opportunity sensed at a distance; windfall, generosity, the near things blur. Ruled domains: Opportunity, Ventures, Father. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正财.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Water directing Fire broadly — depth ranging across warmth as distributed material".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Horizon: light that spends itself gladly. Opportunity finds you at gatherings, luck likes your laugh, and money arrives in blazes and leaves by the same door. You are fortune’s favorite dinner guest. Learn to pocket the bread, and the feast never really ends."
- k2_functional: "You seize chances at speed, brilliant in windows, bored in pipelines."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Flash-chasing","Big spender","Flighty"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Opportunity":"Chances come to you socially: the tip at the table, the partner met at the party. Keep circulating, it is genuinely your economy. Just write things down before the candles burn out.","Ventures":"Your ventures shine at launch: openings, campaigns, anything with a lit fuse and a crowd. Pair every firework with a caretaker who loves the quiet part. That partnership is your fortune.","Father":"The father-thread flickers warm and irregular: a paternal figure of charisma, generosity, or absence in flares. You inherited the shine and the volatility. Spend the first, insure against the second."}
- fn_reading.catalyst.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.catalyst; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 火_正财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Warm-handed","Hardworking","Bankable"],"friction":["Tight-fisted","Anxious","Overcareful"]}
- Sibling cell 火_正财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Money leaves your hands warm. The fair wage rounded up, the invoice paid the day it arrives, the tip that acknowledges the human: your dealings carry heat without waste, and people remember transacting with you the way they remember good meals, specifically and fondly."

Core element Water, energy element Fire. Law: Water tames Fire (水克火: rain ends the blaze). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Fire is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Fire on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Fire as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You see chances early, at their smallest. Being first matters to you more than being sure, and you move while the chance is only a guess. If you name what you see early, the credit stays yours when it pays.

value_b.text: Long before a chance looks like one to anyone else, you see it. You want the far thing while it is cheap rather than the safe one once it is priced. Write down one early call a month and learn which guesses to trust.

value.text: Whenever you see a new chance, you bring it to your partners before the last one pays. You would rather share the next idea than finish the current plan. Once you hand them the finished thing, you keep them for the one after.

value.text: Giving comes easily to you, often before you have counted. Generosity is how you feel rich, so you would rather give the thing now than keep it for a tighter month. Keep giving as you do, and note what each gift costs you.

value_b.text: Good news turns into a gift in your hands before the money lands. You would rather pay than wait to be paid, because open hands are how you feel free. Give as you do, with a few gifts kept small on purpose.

value.text: In a new venture, you start fast and plan later. The beginning is the warm part, and you would rather open the next one than sit through the middle. When you start fast on fewer ventures, you get to know the ones you start.

value_b.text: A fresh start suits you best at speed. Beginning feels more like you than finishing does, because the first move is where your warmth shows. Take the fast start you were built for, with the middle promised to a partner who likes middles.

value.text: The easy part for you is the start. You would rather start something new than wait out a long middle, so most ventures end where the rush does. If each fast start must prove itself after the rush, you lose only the weak ventures.

value.text: You start at full speed, with your partners pulled in beside you. Being at the beginning suits you more than staying for the middle, and the long part lands on them. Name your part before you start, so you ask less of their patience.
